name: Flare Gas to Value & LPG/CNG
enginesVendoredAt: NextGen, sha-identical with engines df31f53 (MD45-1 #228, after MD4-0 #227 and MD5-0 #226). Re-vendored by the lead's commit d39ae319 on this branch; the foundation stood on fe001b52 (f0aef14). This wave does not vendor (gate_vendor.sh compares 15 paths).

plan.state: FOUNDATION: recon, structure, digest, eighteen graded fields, gates, scaffold and task files. No lesson, bank, panel or migration is written.
plan.thesis: A flare is a measured gas before it is an emission or a product: its heating value, its liquids and its carbon come from the analysis by the mole, the flare's CO2 and methane follow the rule's two efficiencies, a route can yield no more than the gas holds and is credited only for the share it recovers against a declared counterfactual, and the LPG vessel, the vaporizer, the carousel, the CNG bank and the cascade are each sized on the basis the engine states.

tiers.beginner: THE GAS AND THE FLARE: characteriseGas (normalisation, heating value on moles, inerts, carbon atom by atom, mass per Mscf, liquids and richness, the mass ceiling) and the flare by 40 CFR 98.233(n) in abatement (CO2 passes through, methane from the methane, destruction and combustion efficiency, CO2e with a stated GWP). Graded: heating value, gpm C3+, C3+ kg/Mscf, flare CO2, CH4, CO2e.
tiers.intermediate: ROUTES, RECOVERY AND THE CREDIT: ROUTE_TEMPLATES, screenRoute, yieldCeiling, routeEconomics (capital by the modular power law), abatement's recovered share and counterfactual, creditSensitivity's breakeven, compareRoutes. Graded: capital, CNG a year, value per Mscf, avoided CO2e, net abatement, breakeven credit price.
tiers.advanced: LPG AND CNG ON THE GROUND: lpgBlendProperties, lpgStorageSizing (fill basis), vaporizerDuty (boiling point at pressure), bottlingPlant (positions wholly working), assetFloat, gasMassInVessel (gauge and absolute, real gas), cascadeFills (equalisation), cngCompression as a unit bridge (never graded), cngDispensing, conversionEconomics. Graded: usable LPG, vaporizer design duty, carousel wait, bank mass, gas left in the cascade, simple payback.

teaching: the Flare Gas to Value Studio's opening gas
the LPG & CNG Rollout Studio's opening carousel and cascade

digest.note: No section is history. Every repaired MD4-0 rule is taught as how the engine works; SECTIONS 14 and 35 state the four HELD items as limits. Every figure is invented and illustrative, and the preamble says so. Extension round on df31f53: every section carries a 'function:' line and the writers' gaps are closed as computed rule rows (RECON 8, REVISE.md).

grading.grader: public.academy_submit_capstone reads expected, tol and the answer as numeric, so every graded field is a number the engine returns and no basis word, verdict, richness band or status is graded.
grading.tolerance: One unit in the last place the digest prints the field's class (precision.json): 1e-4 for the four-decimal classes, 0.01 dollars for capital (the engine rounds dollars to two), 1e-3 kg for the gas left in the cascade (the engine rounds to three), and 0.01 t (ten units) for tonnes of a flare or an abatement, because the engine's LB_PER_KG is the exact reciprocal to nine figures only and on a flare of 300,000 t/yr the oracle and engine part by up to about 1.1e-3 t. One derivation: CLASSES and toleranceOf in gasvalue_capstone.mjs.
grading.collisionRule: No graded value within its tolerance of the absolute value of any number token the digest prints (the go-live rule), and no two graded values within tolerance of each other.
grading.notGraded: Every refusal, note, verdict, richness word and basis word; the flare efficiencies, GWP, credit prices and fill limits as values (HELD H1, H3, H4 are inputs); the unlit flare (H2, not modelled); compressor power and staging (FC3); any NPV, IRR or Monte Carlo; the counts (fills before recharge, positions wholly working, fleets) because an integer graded at 0.5 collides with the digest's integers; carbonAbatement outputs (the carbon course's).

decisions.counts: no count is graded (fills, positions, fleets): an integer at 0.5 collides with the digest's integers
decisions.gauge: the Expert capstone states every CNG pressure as gauge with the site's atmosphere, so the gauge-as-absolute defect (L7) is a live wrong route; the graded value is the engine's return on gauge plus atmosphere
decisions.pre-md4-engine: discriminate.mjs calls petrolord-engines 13f0936 (git archive, read-only in this wave dir) to model the pre-repair defects directly
decisions.compression: cngCompression is taught as a unit bridge (standard volume, psia, stage pressures) and never graded; no compressor power is graded (FC3)
decisions.gwp: GWP values are case inputs (28.7, 27.9 in the capstones; 29.8 in teaching with 20 and 40 beside it for comparison only); no edition is named or chosen
